How it works

One partner. One percentage. All the marketing.

Four steps from the first meeting to the first month. Everything in a contract, with numbers you can see too.

  1. 01

    Free meeting

    30 minutes. We look at your numbers, your offer and where you're losing customers today.

  2. 02

    We calculate the 10%

    Together we agree how gross revenue is measured and what the 10% comes to. We put it in the contract.

  3. 03

    We take care of everything

    Strategy, ads, content, photo, video, website. One team, one contact on WhatsApp.

  4. 04

    You pay 10%, once a month

    The Instagram and Facebook ads are paid from this 10% too. No other invoice.

Who qualifies

Marketing for 10% is for businesses with €5,000+ gross revenue a month.

The 10% is for you if:

  • Your business makes at least €5,000 gross revenue a month
  • You offer services: clinic, lab, salon, restaurant, repair shop
  • Your customers love your service

Not ready for a percentage?

We also offer marketing for a fixed monthly price, with the same quality. It's also the right choice for businesses that sell products, where margins are thin.
